description: Verdict vector of principle 29's matcher (lineIsViolation) over the tracked BROAD kickoff corpus — .claude/orchestrator-prompts/**/kickoff*.md, basename ^kickoff.*\.md$, any depth (430 files at capture, vs the 352 the narrow */kickoff.md sweep reaches). Captured with the CURRENT pre-narrowing matcher (plain-words-recap-v2 S5 commit A) so every later flip is a red test whose fix is a reviewed diff of this file — never a silent pass, never a PR-body listing. Values are 1-based violating line numbers per file; files with zero violations are absent. The sole captured violation (.claude/orchestrator-prompts/plain-words-recap-v2/kickoff-s5.md:[205]) is that stage's own teaching text, examined and dispositioned in the S5 PR — never snapshot-blessed.
